chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Yazīd, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, that he used to say:
“The drowned person is given ghusl (ritual washing).”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in the chain of transmission
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, from whom the ruling is reported

ai.seo_question: Does a person who drowns receive ghusl (ritual washing) before burial in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling that a person who has drowned is to be given ghusl (ritual washing) after death. It belongs to the jurisprudence of funerary rites and clarifies that drowning does not prevent the prescribed purification of the deceased.
